faq.q: How much does Law Office of Gina M Wicik charge?
faq.a: Law Office of Gina M Wicik publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Law Office of Gina M Wicik offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Law Office of Gina M Wicik publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Law Office of Gina M Wicik have offices?
faq.a: Law Office of Gina M Wicik publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Law Office of Gina M Wicik?
faq.a: Law Office of Gina M Wicik names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from.

faq.q: Are the case results Law Office of Gina M Wicik publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Law Office of Gina M Wicik publishes 40 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Law Office of Gina M Wicik?
faq.a: Law Office of Gina M Wicik scores 60 and sits at Listed. Passed: entity registration, website and footprint. Did not pass: licensure and discipline.
